w('grizos/services/grizos-control-plane.mjs', r'''
import http from 'node:http';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';

const bind=process.env.GRIZOS_BIND||'127.0.0.1';
const port=Number(process.env.GRIZOS_PORT||9400);
const db=process.env.GRIZOS_DB||'grizos';
const tokenMapPath=process.env.GRIZOS_TOKEN_MAP||'/etc/gmri/secrets/caller-tokens.json';
const identityDir=process.env.GRIZOS_IDENTITY_DIR||'/etc/gmri/identities';
const authorityDir=process.env.GRIZOS_AUTHORITY_DIR||'/etc/gmri/authority';
const maxBody=1024*1024;

function now(){return new Date().toISOString()}
function id(prefix){return `${prefix}_${crypto.randomUUID()}`}
function hash(s){return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex')}
function readJson(p){return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'))}
let tokenMap=readJson(tokenMapPath);
let profiles=new Map();
let identities=new Map();

function reloadPolicy(){
  profiles=new Map(); identities=new Map();
  for(const f of fs.readdirSync(authorityDir).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json'))){const o=readJson(`${authorityDir}/${f}`);profiles.set(o.profile_id,o)}
  for(const f of fs.readdirSync(identityDir).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.identity.json'))){const o=readJson(`${identityDir}/${f}`);identities.set(o.intelligence_id,o)}
  tokenMap=readJson(tokenMapPath);
}

function psql(sql, vars={}){
  const args=['-X','-qAt','--set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1','--dbname',db];
  for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(vars)) args.push('-v',`${k}=${v===null?'':String(v)}`);
  args.push('-c',sql);
  const r=spawnSync('psql',args,{encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:8*1024*1024});
  if(r.status!==0) throw new Error(`psql failed: ${String(r.stderr).trim()}`);
  return String(r.stdout).trim();
}
function qjson(sql, vars={}){const s=psql(sql,vars);return s?JSON.parse(s):null}

function caller(req){
  const h=req.headers.authorization||''; if(!h.startsWith('Bearer ')) return null;
  const token=h.slice(7); const digest=hash(token);
  for(const [who,expected] of Object.entries(tokenMap.callers||{})) if(crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(digest),Buffer.from(expected))) return who;
  return null;
}
function profileFor(who){
  if(who==='operator') return {profile_id:'operator',allowed:['*'],denied:[],mutation_requires_operator:false};
  const ident=identities.get(who); if(!ident) return profiles.get(who)||null;
  return profiles.get(String(ident.authority_profile_ref||'').split('/').pop())||null;
}
function authorized(who,action){
  const p=profileFor(who); if(!p) return false;
  if((p.denied||[]).includes(action)) return false;
  return (p.allowed||[]).includes('*')||(p.allowed||[]).includes(action);
}
function send(res,status,obj){const body=JSON.stringify(obj);res.writeHead(status,{'content-type':'application/json','cache-control':'no-store'});res.end(body)}
async function body(req){let n=0,chunks=[];for await(const c of req){n+=c.length;if(n>maxBody)throw new Error('body too large');chunks.push(c)};if(!chunks.length)return {};return JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'))}
function event(event_type,actor_id,subject_id=null,mission_id=null,payload={},epistemic_state=null){
  const event_id=id('evt');
  qjson(`INSERT INTO events(event_id,event_type,actor_id,subject_id,mission_id,epistemic_state,payload) VALUES(:'eid',:'etype',:'actor',NULLIF(:'subject',''),NULLIF(:'mission',''),NULLIF(:'epi',''),:'payload'::jsonb) RETURNING row_to_json(events)::text`,{eid:event_id,etype:event_type,actor:actor_id,subject:subject_id||'',mission:mission_id||'',epi:epistemic_state||'',payload:JSON.stringify(payload)});
  return event_id;
}
function deny(res,who,action,detail={}){event('AUTHORITY_DENIED',who||'unauthenticated',who,null,{action,...detail},'VERIFIED_PRIMARY');send(res,403,{status:'DENIED',caller:who,action})}

function syncStatic(){
  for(const ident of identities.values()){
    qjson(`INSERT INTO intelligences(intelligence_id,identity_manifest_ref,lineage_version,memory_namespace_ref,authority_profile_ref,relationship_state_ref,active_model_binding,model_binding_history,status) VALUES(:'iid',:'imr',:'lv',:'mnr',:'apr',NULLIF(:'rsr',''),NULLIF(:'amb',''),:'mbh'::jsonb,'REGISTERED') ON CONFLICT(intelligence_id) DO UPDATE SET identity_manifest_ref=excluded.identity_manifest_ref,lineage_version=excluded.lineage_version,memory_namespace_ref=excluded.memory_namespace_ref,authority_profile_ref=excluded.authority_profile_ref,relationship_state_ref=excluded.relationship_state_ref,updated_at=now() RETURNING row_to_json(intelligences)::text`,{iid:ident.intelligence_id,imr:ident.identity_manifest_ref,lv:ident.lineage_version,mnr:ident.memory_namespace_ref,apr:ident.authority_profile_ref,rsr:ident.relationship_state_ref||'',amb:ident.active_model_binding||'',mbh:JSON.stringify(ident.model_binding_history||[])});
  }
  for(const p of profiles.values()) qjson(`INSERT INTO authority_profiles(profile_id,allowed,denied,mutation_requires_operator) VALUES(:'id',:'allowed'::jsonb,:'denied'::jsonb,:'mro'::boolean) ON CONFLICT(profile_id) DO UPDATE SET allowed=excluded.allowed,denied=excluded.denied,mutation_requires_operator=excluded.mutation_requires_operator,updated_at=now() RETURNING row_to_json(authority_profiles)::text`,{id:p.profile_id,allowed:JSON.stringify(p.allowed||[]),denied:JSON.stringify(p.denied||[]),mro:String(Boolean(p.mutation_requires_operator))});
}

reloadPolicy(); syncStatic();

const server=http.createServer(async(req,res)=>{
  try{
    const url=new URL(req.url,`http://${req.headers.host||'localhost'}`);
    if(url.pathname==='/healthz'&&req.method==='GET') return send(res,200,{status:'ok',time:now(),database:qjson(`SELECT json_build_object('ok',true,'now',now())::text`)});
    const who=caller(req); if(!who) return send(res,401,{status:'UNAUTHENTICATED'});
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/policy/reload'&&req.method==='POST') {if(who!=='operator')return deny(res,who,'IDENTITY_POLICY_WRITE');reloadPolicy();syncStatic();event('POLICY_RELOADED',who);return send(res,200,{status:'OK'});}
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/intelligences'&&req.method==='GET') return send(res,200,qjson(`SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t),'[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT * FROM intelligences ORDER BY intelligence_id)t`));
    if(url.pathname.startsWith('/v1/intelligences/')&&req.method==='GET'){
      const iid=decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice('/v1/intelligences/'.length));
      const row=qjson(`SELECT row_to_json(t)::text FROM (SELECT * FROM intelligences WHERE intelligence_id=:'iid')t`,{iid});
      return row?send(res,200,row):send(res,404,{status:'NOT_FOUND'});
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/authority/check'&&req.method==='POST'){
      const b=await body(req); const subject=b.subject_id||who; const action=String(b.action||'');
      if(who!=='operator'&&who!==subject&&who!=='gmri:dottie-hill') return deny(res,who,'AUTHORITY_CHECK_OTHER');
      const allow=authorized(subject,action); event(allow?'AUTHORITY_ALLOWED':'AUTHORITY_DENIED',who,subject,null,{action},'VERIFIED_PRIMARY');
      return send(res,allow?200:403,{status:allow?'ALLOWED':'DENIED',subject_id:subject,action,profile:profileFor(subject)?.profile_id||null});
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/missions'&&req.method==='POST'){
      if(!authorized(who,'MISSION_DISPATCH_AEGIS')&&who!=='operator'&&who!=='system:field') return deny(res,who,'MISSION_DISPATCH_AEGIS');
      const b=await body(req); const assigned=String(b.assigned_id||''); if(!identities.has(assigned)) return send(res,400,{status:'UNKNOWN_ASSIGNEE',assigned});
      const mid=b.mission_id||id('mis'); const ik=String(b.idempotency_key||''); if(!ik) return send(res,400,{status:'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED'});
      const row=qjson(`INSERT INTO missions(mission_id,parent_mission_id,idempotency_key,requester_id,assigned_id,mission_type,payload,authority_scope,consequence_class) VALUES(:'mid',NULLIF(:'parent',''),:'ik',:'req',:'assignee',:'mtype',:'payload'::jsonb,:'scope'::jsonb,:'cc') ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET idempotency_key=missions.idempotency_key RETURNING row_to_json(missions)::text`,{mid,parent:b.parent_mission_id||'',ik,req:who,assignee:assigned,mtype:b.mission_type||'generic',payload:JSON.stringify(b.payload||{}),scope:JSON.stringify(b.authority_scope||[]),cc:b.consequence_class||'READ_ONLY'});
      event('MISSION_DISPATCHED',who,assigned,row.mission_id,{mission_type:row.mission_type,idempotency_key:ik}); return send(res,201,row);
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/missions'&&req.method==='GET'){
      const assigned=url.searchParams.get('assigned_to')||who; if(who!=='operator'&&assigned!==who) return deny(res,who,'MISSION_READ_OTHER');
      const status=url.searchParams.get('status')||'PENDING'; const limit=Math.min(50,Math.max(1,Number(url.searchParams.get('limit')||10)));
      return send(res,200,qjson(`SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t),'[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT * FROM missions WHERE assigned_id=:'assigned' AND status=:'status' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT ${limit})t`,{assigned,status}));
    }
    const mclaim=url.pathname.match(/^\/v1\/missions\/([^/]+)\/claim$/);
    if(mclaim&&req.method==='POST'){
      const mid=decodeURIComponent(mclaim[1]); const b=await body(req);
      const row=qjson(`UPDATE missions SET status='RUNNING',worker_id=:'worker',claimed_at=COALESCE(claimed_at,now()) WHERE mission_id=:'mid' AND assigned_id=:'assignee' AND status IN ('PENDING','RECONCILE') RETURNING row_to_json(missions)::text`,{worker:b.worker_id||'',mid,assignee:who});
      if(!row)return send(res,409,{status:'NOT_CLAIMABLE'});event('MISSION_CLAIMED',who,who,mid,{worker_id:b.worker_id||''});return send(res,200,row);
    }
    const mrecon=url.pathname.match(/^\/v1\/missions\/([^/]+)\/reconcile$/);
    if(mrecon&&req.method==='POST'){
      const mid=decodeURIComponent(mrecon[1]); const row=qjson(`SELECT row_to_json(t)::text FROM (SELECT * FROM missions WHERE mission_id=:'mid' AND assigned_id=:'assignee')t`,{mid,assignee:who});
      if(!row)return send(res,404,{status:'NOT_FOUND'});
      if(row.consequence_class!=='READ_ONLY') {qjson(`UPDATE missions SET status='BLOCKED',last_error='restart reconciliation requires operator for consequential mission' WHERE mission_id=:'mid' RETURNING row_to_json(missions)::text`,{mid});event('RECONCILIATION_BLOCKED',who,who,mid,{consequence_class:row.consequence_class});return send(res,409,{status:'BLOCKED_REQUIRES_OPERATOR'});}
      qjson(`UPDATE missions SET status='RECONCILE',worker_id=NULL WHERE mission_id=:'mid' RETURNING row_to_json(missions)::text`,{mid});event('MISSION_RECONCILED',who,who,mid,{action:'reset_read_only_for_idempotent_resume'});return send(res,200,{status:'RECONCILE'});
    }
    const mcomplete=url.pathname.match(/^\/v1\/missions\/([^/]+)\/complete$/);
    if(mcomplete&&req.method==='POST'){
      const mid=decodeURIComponent(mcomplete[1]); const b=await body(req);
      const row=qjson(`UPDATE missions SET status=:'status',completed_at=now(),last_error=NULLIF(:'err','') WHERE mission_id=:'mid' AND assigned_id=:'assignee' RETURNING row_to_json(missions)::text`,{status:b.status||'COMPLETED',err:b.error||'',mid,assignee:who});
      if(!row)return send(res,404,{status:'NOT_FOUND'});event('MISSION_COMPLETED',who,who,mid,{status:row.status});return send(res,200,row);
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/evidence'&&req.method==='POST'){
      if(!authorized(who,'EVIDENCE_RECORD'))return deny(res,who,'EVIDENCE_RECORD'); const b=await body(req); const eid=b.evidence_id||id('evd');
      const row=qjson(`INSERT INTO evidence(evidence_id,mission_id,source_uri,source_kind,source_hash,observed_at,freshness_state,confidence,classification,metadata) VALUES(:'eid',NULLIF(:'mid',''),:'uri',:'kind',NULLIF(:'hash',''),:'obs'::timestamptz,:'fresh',NULLIF(:'conf','')::double precision,:'class',:'meta'::jsonb) RETURNING row_to_json(evidence)::text`,{eid,mid:b.mission_id||'',uri:b.source_uri||'',kind:b.source_kind||'unknown',hash:b.source_hash||'',obs:b.observed_at||now(),fresh:b.freshness_state||'CURRENT',conf:b.confidence??'',class:b.classification||'ATTRIBUTED',meta:JSON.stringify(b.metadata||{})});
      event('EVIDENCE_RECORDED',who,eid,b.mission_id||null,{classification:row.classification,source_uri:row.source_uri},row.classification);return send(res,201,row);
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/findings'&&req.method==='POST'){
      if(!authorized(who,'FINDING_RECORD'))return deny(res,who,'FINDING_RECORD'); const b=await body(req); const fid=b.finding_id||id('fnd');
      const row=qjson(`INSERT INTO findings(finding_id,mission_id,author_intelligence_id,proposition,epistemic_state,confidence,evidence_ids,status) VALUES(:'fid',:'mid',:'author',:'prop',:'epi',NULLIF(:'conf','')::double precision,:'eids'::jsonb,'ACTIVE') RETURNING row_to_json(findings)::text`,{fid,mid:b.mission_id||'',author:who,prop:b.proposition||'',epi:b.epistemic_state||'ATTRIBUTED',conf:b.confidence??'',eids:JSON.stringify(b.evidence_ids||[])});
      event('FINDING_RECORDED',who,fid,b.mission_id||null,{epistemic_state:row.epistemic_state},row.epistemic_state);return send(res,201,row);
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/findings'&&req.method==='GET'){
      const mid=url.searchParams.get('mission_id')||''; return send(res,200,qjson(`SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t),'[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT * FROM findings WHERE (:'mid'='' OR mission_id=:'mid') ORDER BY created_at)t`,{mid}));
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/world/objects'&&req.method==='POST'){
      if(!authorized(who,'WORLD_STATE_PROJECT')&&who!=='operator')return deny(res,who,'WORLD_STATE_PROJECT'); const b=await body(req); if(!b.object_id)return send(res,400,{status:'OBJECT_ID_REQUIRED'});
      const row=qjson(`INSERT INTO world_objects(object_id,object_type,state,provenance,confidence,source_time) VALUES(:'oid',:'otype',:'state'::jsonb,:'prov'::jsonb,NULLIF(:'conf','')::double precision,NULLIF(:'stime','')::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT(object_id) DO UPDATE SET state=excluded.state,provenance=excluded.provenance,confidence=excluded.confidence,source_time=excluded.source_time,updated_at=now() RETURNING row_to_json(world_objects)::text`,{oid:b.object_id,otype:b.object_type||'unknown',state:JSON.stringify(b.state||{}),prov:JSON.stringify(b.provenance||{}),conf:b.confidence??'',stime:b.source_time||''});
      const weid=id('wev'); qjson(`INSERT INTO world_events(event_id,object_id,actor_id,event_type,delta,provenance,source_time) VALUES(:'eid',:'oid',:'actor',:'etype',:'delta'::jsonb,:'prov'::jsonb,NULLIF(:'stime','')::timestamptz) RETURNING row_to_json(world_events)::text`,{eid:weid,oid:b.object_id,actor:who,etype:b.event_type||'UPSERT',delta:JSON.stringify(b.state||{}),prov:JSON.stringify(b.provenance||{}),stime:b.source_time||''});event('WORLD_OBJECT_UPDATED',who,b.object_id,null,{world_event_id:weid});return send(res,201,row);
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/world/objects'&&req.method==='GET') return send(res,200,qjson(`SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t),'[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT * FROM world_objects ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5000)t`));
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/world/events'&&req.method==='GET'){
      const after=Number(url.searchParams.get('after')||0);return send(res,200,qjson(`SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t),'[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT * FROM world_events WHERE seq>${Number.isFinite(after)?after:0} ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1000)t`));
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/shares'&&req.method==='POST'){
      if(!authorized(who,'MEMORY_SHARE_EVIDENCE')&&who!=='operator')return deny(res,who,'MEMORY_SHARE_EVIDENCE'); const b=await body(req); const sid=b.share_id||id('shr');
      const row=qjson(`INSERT INTO shares(share_id,from_namespace,to_namespace,evidence_id,actor_id,authorization_ref) VALUES(:'sid',:'from',:'to',:'eid',:'actor',:'auth') RETURNING row_to_json(shares)::text`,{sid,from:b.from_namespace||'',to:b.to_namespace||'',eid:b.evidence_id||'',actor:who,auth:b.authorization_ref||''});event('EVIDENCE_SHARED',who,b.to_namespace||'',null,{share_id:sid,evidence_id:b.evidence_id||''});return send(res,201,row);
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/alerts'&&req.method==='POST'){
      if(!authorized(who,'ALERT_OPERATOR'))return deny(res,who,'ALERT_OPERATOR'); const b=await body(req); const ik=String(b.idempotency_key||''); if(!ik)return send(res,400,{status:'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED'}); const rid=id('rcp');
      const row=qjson(`INSERT INTO receipts(receipt_id,actor_id,action,authority_ref,target,idempotency_key,status,detail) VALUES(:'rid',:'actor','ALERT_OPERATOR',:'auth',:'target',:'ik','RECORDED',:'detail'::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET idempotency_key=receipts.idempotency_key RETURNING row_to_json(receipts)::text`,{rid,actor:who,auth:profileFor(who)?.profile_id||'',target:b.target||'operator',ik,detail:JSON.stringify(b.detail||{})});event('OPERATOR_ALERT',who,row.receipt_id,null,{idempotency_key:ik});return send(res,201,row);
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/events'&&req.method==='GET'){
      const after=Number(url.searchParams.get('after')||0);return send(res,200,qjson(`SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t),'[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT * FROM events WHERE seq>${Number.isFinite(after)?after:0} ORDER BY seq LIMIT 2000)t`));
    }
    if(url.pathname==='/v1/state'&&req.method==='GET'){
      const result=qjson(`SELECT json_build_object('intelligences',(SELECT count(*) FROM intelligences),'pending_missions',(SELECT count(*) FROM missions WHERE status='PENDING'),'running_missions',(SELECT count(*) FROM missions WHERE status='RUNNING'),'events',(SELECT count(*) FROM events),'evidence',(SELECT count(*) FROM evidence),'findings',(SELECT count(*) FROM findings),'world_objects',(SELECT count(*) FROM world_objects),'latest_event',(SELECT max(created_at) FROM events))::text`);return send(res,200,result);
    }
    return send(res,404,{status:'NOT_FOUND'});
  }catch(e){console.error(e);send(res,500,{status:'ERROR',error:String(e.message||e)})}
});
server.listen(port,bind,()=>console.log(JSON.stringify({service:'grizos-control-plane',bind,port,time:now()})));
''')

w('grizos/services/holograph_adapter.py', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse,json,os,sys
from pathlib import Path

def guard(path):
    p=Path(path).resolve()
    root=Path('/var/lib/gmri/memory').resolve()
    if root not in p.parents:
        raise SystemExit('memory path outside GMRI memory root')
    return p

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('action',choices=['store','recall','summary']); ap.add_argument('--db',required=True); ap.add_argument('--text'); ap.add_argument('--query'); ap.add_argument('--anchor',default='runtime')
    a=ap.parse_args(); db=guard(a.db); db.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    from holograph.runtime import HoloGraph
    hg=HoloGraph(kernel_kind='real',db_path=str(db))
    try:
        if a.action=='store':
            if not a.text: raise SystemExit('--text required')
            triples=hg.ingest_text(a.text,anchor=a.anchor)
            print(json.dumps({'stored':len(triples),'summary':hg.summary()},default=str))
        elif a.action=='recall':
            if not a.query: raise SystemExit('--query required')
            out=hg.read(a.query)
            # ReaderOutput is a dataclass-like object; expose only JSON-safe public fields.
            d={k:v for k,v in vars(out).items() if not k.startswith('_')}
            print(json.dumps(d,default=lambda x: getattr(x,'tolist',lambda: str(x))()))
        else: print(json.dumps(hg.summary()))
    finally: hg.close()
if __name__=='__main__': main()
''',0o755)

w('grizos/services/gmri-intelligence-runtime.mjs', r'''
import http from 'node:http';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';

const iid=process.env.GMRI_INTELLIGENCE_ID;
const manifestPath=process.env.GMRI_IDENTITY_MANIFEST;
const tokenFile=process.env.GMRI_TOKEN_FILE;
const grizos=process.env.GRIZOS_URL||'http://127.0.0.1:9400';
const ollama=process.env.OLLAMA_BASE_URL||'http://127.0.0.1:11434';
const memoryDb=process.env.GMRI_MEMORY_DB;
const memoryPy=process.env.GMRI_HOLOGRAPH_PY||'/opt/gmri/venv-holograph/bin/python';
const memoryAdapter=process.env.GMRI_HOLOGRAPH_ADAPTER||'/opt/gmri/current/grizos/services/holograph_adapter.py';
const allowlistPath=process.env.GMRI_REPO_ALLOWLIST||'/etc/gmri/repo-allowlist.txt';
const healthPort=Number(process.env.GMRI_HEALTH_PORT||9500);
if(!iid||!manifestPath||!tokenFile||!memoryDb) throw new Error('required runtime env missing');
const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath,'utf8'));
if(manifest.intelligence_id!==iid) throw new Error('identity manifest mismatch');
const token=fs.readFileSync(tokenFile,'utf8').trim();
const workerId=`worker_${process.pid}_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
let liveModel=manifest.active_model_binding;
let status={state:'BOOTING',worker_id:workerId,last_mission:null,last_error:null,model:liveModel,started_at:new Date().toISOString()};
const headers={'content-type':'application/json','authorization':`Bearer ${token}`};
const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));

async function api(path,opts={}){const r=await fetch(grizos+path,{...opts,headers:{...headers,...(opts.headers||{})}});const t=await r.text();let b;try{b=JSON.parse(t)}catch{b={raw:t}};if(!r.ok){const e=new Error(`GrizOS ${r.status} ${path}`);e.body=b;throw e}return b}
function sha(s){return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex')}
function allowedRepos(){if(!fs.existsSync(allowlistPath))return[];return fs.readFileSync(allowlistPath,'utf8').split(/\r?\n/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(x=>x&&!x.startsWith('#')).map(x=>fs.realpathSync(x))}
function repoEvidence(path){
  const rp=fs.realpathSync(path); if(!allowedRepos().includes(rp)) throw new Error(`repo not allowlisted: ${rp}`);
  const cmd=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync('git',['-C',rp,...args],{encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:2*1024*1024});if(r.status!==0)throw new Error(`git ${args.join(' ')}: ${r.stderr}`);return r.stdout.trim()};
  const head=cmd(['rev-parse','HEAD']), branch=cmd(['branch','--show-current']), statusText=cmd(['status','--porcelain=v1']), last=cmd(['log','-1','--format=%H%n%aI%n%s%n%b']);
  return {repo_path:rp,head,branch,dirty:Boolean(statusText),status:statusText,last_commit:last};
}
function mem(action,args){const av=[memoryAdapter,action,'--db',memoryDb];for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(args||{}))if(v!==undefined&&v!==null)av.push(`--${k}`,String(v));const r=spawnSync(memoryPy,av,{encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:4*1024*1024});if(r.status!==0)throw new Error(`memory adapter: ${r.stderr||r.stdout}`);return JSON.parse(r.stdout)}
function systemPrompt(){return `You are a persistent GMRI digital intelligence, not a fictional role-play session. Identity: ${manifest.display_name} (${iid}). Epistemic salience: ${manifest.epistemic_salience||manifest.roles?.join(', ')||'watch/evidence'}. Constraint: ${manifest.lineage_constraint||manifest.behavioral_contract?.join('; ')||''}. Preserve provenance. Do not invent observations. Distinguish VERIFIED_PRIMARY, CORROBORATED, ATTRIBUTED, UNVERIFIED, CONTRADICTED, CHANGED, RETRACTED_CORRECTED. Perform mandatory disconfirmation for material propositions. Return strict JSON with keys proposition, epistemic_state, confidence, evidence_summary, disconfirming_evidence, recommended_action, urgency. No markdown.`}
async function infer(evidence,mission){
  const r=await fetch(ollama+'/api/chat',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({model:liveModel,stream:false,format:'json',messages:[{role:'system',content:systemPrompt()},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify({mission:{mission_id:mission.mission_id,mission_type:mission.mission_type,payload:mission.payload},evidence})}]})});
  const t=await r.text(); if(!r.ok) throw new Error(`provider ${r.status}: ${t.slice(0,500)}`); const j=JSON.parse(t); const content=j.message?.content??j.response; if(!content)throw new Error('provider returned no content');
  let parsed; try{parsed=JSON.parse(content)}catch{throw new Error('provider did not return requested JSON')}
  return {provider_receipt:{model:j.model||liveModel,created_at:j.created_at||null,done_reason:j.done_reason||null,total_duration:j.total_duration||null},result:parsed,raw_hash:sha(content)};
}
async function authorize(action){try{await api('/v1/authority/check',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({subject_id:iid,action})});return true}catch{return false}}
async function processMission(m){
  status.state='WORKING';status.last_mission=m.mission_id;
  const claimed=await api(`/v1/missions/${encodeURIComponent(m.mission_id)}/claim`,{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({worker_id:workerId})});
  let evidencePayload={}; let sourceUri='runtime://unknown'; let sourceKind='system';
  if(claimed.mission_type==='repo_watch'){
    if(!await authorize('REPO_INSPECT'))throw new Error('authority denied REPO_INSPECT');
    evidencePayload=repoEvidence(claimed.payload.repo_path);sourceUri=`git://${evidencePayload.repo_path}@${evidencePayload.head}`;sourceKind='git';
  }else if(claimed.mission_type==='system_health'){
    evidencePayload=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/var/lib/gmri/health/latest.json','utf8'));sourceUri='gmri://production-health';sourceKind='system-health';
  }else{throw new Error(`unsupported mission_type ${claimed.mission_type}`)}
  const evidenceText=JSON.stringify(evidencePayload);
  const ev=await api('/v1/evidence',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({mission_id:m.mission_id,source_uri:sourceUri,source_kind:sourceKind,source_hash:sha(evidenceText),observed_at:new Date().toISOString(),freshness_state:'CURRENT',confidence:1.0,classification:'VERIFIED_PRIMARY',metadata:evidencePayload})});
  let memoryContext=null; try{memoryContext=mem('recall',{query:claimed.payload.query||claimed.mission_type})}catch(e){memoryContext={status:'MEMORY_RECALL_DEGRADED',error:String(e.message)}}
  const inf=await infer({current:evidencePayload,memory_context:memoryContext},claimed);
  const result=inf.result;
  const finding=await api('/v1/findings',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({mission_id:m.mission_id,proposition:String(result.proposition||''),epistemic_state:result.epistemic_state||'ATTRIBUTED',confidence:Number(result.confidence??0.5),evidence_ids:[ev.evidence_id],provider_receipt:inf.provider_receipt,raw_hash:inf.raw_hash})});
  try{mem('store',{text:`${result.proposition}\nEvidence: ${sourceUri}`,anchor:finding.finding_id})}catch(e){status.last_error=`memory store degraded: ${e.message}`}
  if(iid==='gmri:dottie-hill' && Array.isArray(claimed.payload.aegis_reviewers)){
    for(const reviewer of claimed.payload.aegis_reviewers){
      await api('/v1/missions',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({parent_mission_id:m.mission_id,idempotency_key:`${m.mission_id}:${reviewer}:review`,assigned_id:reviewer,mission_type:claimed.mission_type,consequence_class:'READ_ONLY',payload:{...claimed.payload,aegis_reviewers:[],source_parent_mission:m.mission_id,query:`Independently review the same real evidence. Do not adopt Dottie's conclusion; seek disagreement if supported.`},authority_scope:['OBSERVE','RETRIEVE','COMPARE','REASON','COLLECT_EVIDENCE','REPORT']})});
    }
  }
  await api(`/v1/missions/${encodeURIComponent(m.mission_id)}/complete`,{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({status:'COMPLETED'})});status.state='IDLE';status.last_error=null;
}
async function reconcile(){
  let running=[];try{running=await api('/v1/missions?status=RUNNING&assigned_to='+encodeURIComponent(iid)+'&limit=20')}catch{}
  for(const m of running){try{await api(`/v1/missions/${encodeURIComponent(m.mission_id)}/reconcile`,{method:'POST',body:'{}'})}catch(e){status.last_error=`reconcile ${m.mission_id}: ${e.message}`}}
}
async function loop(){
  await api('/v1/intelligences/'+encodeURIComponent(iid)); await reconcile(); status.state='IDLE';
  while(true){try{const ms=await api('/v1/missions?status=PENDING&assigned_to='+encodeURIComponent(iid)+'&limit=1');if(ms.length)await processMission(ms[0]);else{const rs=await api('/v1/missions?status=RECONCILE&assigned_to='+encodeURIComponent(iid)+'&limit=1');if(rs.length)await processMission(rs[0]);}}catch(e){status.state='DEGRADED';status.last_error=e.message;console.error(e)}await sleep(2000)}
}
http.createServer((req,res)=>{if(req.url==='/healthz'){res.writeHead(status.state==='BOOTING'?503:200,{'content-type':'application/json'});res.end(JSON.stringify({...status,intelligence_id:iid}));}else{res.writeHead(404);res.end()}}).listen(healthPort,'127.0.0.1');
loop().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)});
''')

w('grizos/services/generate_auth_files.sh', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
[[ ${EUID:-$(id -u)} -eq 0 ]] || { echo 'root required' >&2; exit 2; }
SEED=/etc/gmri/secrets/auth.seed
[[ -s "$SEED" ]] || { echo 'Missing operator-owned seed. Run bootstrap/install_secret_seed.sh.' >&2; exit 3; }
install -d -m 0700 /etc/gmri/secrets/tokens
python3 - "$SEED" <<'PY'
import hashlib,hmac,json,os,pwd,sys
seed=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read().strip()
callers=['operator','gmri:dottie-hill','gmri:aegis:dugan','gmri:aegis:jones','gmri:aegis:morita','gmri:aegis:falsworth','gmri:aegis:dernier','system:health','system:field','system:gev']
files={'operator':'operator','gmri:dottie-hill':'dottie','gmri:aegis:dugan':'dugan','gmri:aegis:jones':'jones','gmri:aegis:morita':'morita','gmri:aegis:falsworth':'falsworth','gmri:aegis:dernier':'dernier','system:health':'health','system:field':'field','system:gev':'gev'}
mp={'callers':{}}
for c in callers:
    tok=hmac.new(seed,('gmri-service-token|'+c).encode(),hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    mp['callers'][c]=hashlib.sha256(tok.encode()).hexdigest()
    p=f"/etc/gmri/secrets/tokens/{files[c]}.token"
    with open(p,'w') as f:f.write(tok+'\n')
    os.chmod(p,0o640)
with open('/etc/gmri/secrets/caller-tokens.json','w') as f: json.dump(mp,f,indent=2)
os.chmod('/etc/gmri/secrets/caller-tokens.json',0o640)
PY
# Assign service-readable token ownership where users exist.
for u in dottie dugan jones morita falsworth dernier; do id "gmri-$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 && chown root:"gmri-$u" "/etc/gmri/secrets/tokens/$u.token" || true; done
id grizos >/dev/null 2>&1 && chown root:grizos /etc/gmri/secrets/caller-tokens.json || true
chmod 0600 "$SEED"
''',0o755)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
install -d -m 0750 -o grizos -g grizos /var/lib/gmri/health
services=(postgresql gmri-grizos gmri-intelligence@dottie gmri-intelligence@dugan gmri-intelligence@morita gmri-gev-gateway)

import json,subprocess,sys,datetime,shutil,os
out={'observed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'services':{},'disk':{},'provider':{}}
for s in sys.argv[1:]:
    p=subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active',s],text=True,capture_output=True)
    out['services'][s]={'active':p.returncode==0,'state':p.stdout.strip() or p.stderr.strip()}
st=shutil.disk_usage('/var/lib/gmri');out['disk']={'total':st.total,'used':st.used,'free':st.free,'free_fraction':st.free/st.total}
try:
    import urllib.request
    with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags',timeout=3) as r: out['provider']={'reachable':True,'status':r.status}
except Exception as e: out['provider']={'reachable':False,'error':str(e)}
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
PY
chown grizos:grizos /var/lib/gmri/health/latest.json
chmod 0640 /var/lib/gmri/health/latest.json
''',0o755)

w('grizos/services/field_tick.sh', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/opt/gmri/current
CFG=/etc/gmri/field_missions.json
TOKEN=$(cat /etc/gmri/secrets/tokens/field.token)
BASE=http://127.0.0.1:9400
SLOT=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M)
python3 - "$CFG" "$SLOT" <<'PY' | while IFS= read -r row; do
import json,sys
cfg=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));slot=sys.argv[2]
for m in cfg['missions']:
  print(json.dumps({'name':m['name'],'slot':slot,'mission':m}))
PY
  name=$(printf '%s' "$row" | jq -r .name)
  mtype=$(printf '%s' "$row" | jq -r .mission.type)
  assigned=$(printf '%s' "$row" | jq -r .mission.assigned_to)
  if [[ "$mtype" == repo_watch ]]; then
    match=$(printf '%s' "$row" | jq -r .mission.repo_match)
    repo=$(grep -E "/${match}$" /etc/gmri/repo-allowlist.txt | head -n1 || true)
    [[ -n "$repo" ]] || continue
    payload=$(printf '%s' "$row" | jq --arg repo "$repo" '.mission + {repo_path:$repo,query:("Watch the real " + .mission.repo_match + " repository for material change; preserve provenance and disconfirm your first conclusion.")}')
  else
    payload=$(printf '%s' "$row" | jq '.mission + {query:"Assess real production health for material changes and consequences."}')
  fi
  body=$(jq -n --arg ik "field:${name}:${SLOT}" --arg ass "$assigned" --arg mt "$mtype" --argjson payload "$payload" '{idempotency_key:$ik,assigned_id:$ass,mission_type:$mt,consequence_class:"READ_ONLY",authority_scope:["OBSERVE","RETRIEVE","COMPARE","REASON","INVESTIGATE","COLLECT_EVIDENCE","REPORT","ALERT"],payload:$payload}')
  curl --fail --silent --show-error -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$body" "$BASE/v1/missions" >/dev/null || true
done
''',0o755)

w('grizos/recovery/backup_state.sh', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
STAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
DEST=/var/backups/gmri/$STAMP
install -d -m 0700 "$DEST"
sudo -u grizos pg_dump -Fc grizos > "$DEST/grizos.dump"
for d in /var/lib/gmri/memory/*; do
  [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
  n=$(basename "$d")
  if [[ -f "$d/holograph.db" ]]; then
    sudo -u "gmri-$n" sqlite3 "$d/holograph.db" ".backup '$DEST/holograph-$n.db'" 2>/dev/null || cp --reflink=auto "$d/holograph.db" "$DEST/holograph-$n.db"
  fi
done
cp -a /etc/gmri/identities "$DEST/identities"
cp -a /etc/gmri/authority "$DEST/authority"
find "$DEST" -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > "$DEST/MANIFEST.sha256"
printf '%s\n' "$DEST"
''',0o755)

w('grizos/recovery/restore_verify.sh', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
BACKUP=${1:?backup directory required}
[[ -f "$BACKUP/grizos.dump" && -f "$BACKUP/MANIFEST.sha256" ]] || { echo 'invalid backup dir' >&2; exit 2; }
(cd "$BACKUP" && sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256)
DB="grizos_restore_verify_$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
sudo -u postgres createdb "$DB"
trap 'sudo -u postgres dropdb --if-exists "$DB" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
sudo -u postgres pg_restore -d "$DB" "$BACKUP/grizos.dump"
sudo -u postgres psql -d "$DB" -At -c "SELECT json_build_object('intelligences',(SELECT count(*) FROM intelligences),'events',(SELECT count(*) FROM events),'evidence',(SELECT count(*) FROM evidence))::text;"
for f in "$BACKUP"/holograph-*.db; do [[ -e "$f" ]] || continue; sqlite3 "$f" 'PRAGMA integrity_check;' | grep -qx ok; done
echo 'SAFE_RESTORE_VERIFY_PASS'
''',0o755)

w('spatial-gev/adapters/grizos-gev-gateway.mjs', r'''
import http from 'node:http';
import fs from 'node:fs';
const bind=process.env.GEV_GATEWAY_BIND||'127.0.0.1';
const port=Number(process.env.GEV_GATEWAY_PORT||9410);
const grizos=process.env.GRIZOS_URL||'http://127.0.0.1:9400';
const token=fs.readFileSync(process.env.GMRI_GEV_TOKEN_FILE||'/etc/gmri/secrets/tokens/gev.token','utf8').trim();
const headers={'authorization':`Bearer ${token}`};
async function get(path){const r=await fetch(grizos+path,{headers});if(!r.ok)throw new Error(`GrizOS ${r.status}`);return r.json()}
http.createServer(async(req,res)=>{
  try{
    if(req.url==='/healthz'){const s=await get('/v1/state');res.writeHead(200,{'content-type':'application/json'});return res.end(JSON.stringify({status:'ok',grizos:s}));}
    if(req.url==='/api/grizos/world'){const rows=await get('/v1/world/objects');res.writeHead(200,{'content-type':'application/json','cache-control':'no-store','access-control-allow-origin':'http://127.0.0.1:4173'});return res.end(JSON.stringify(rows));}
    res.writeHead(404);res.end();
  }catch(e){res.writeHead(503,{'content-type':'application/json'});res.end(JSON.stringify({status:'degraded',error:String(e.message||e)}));}
}).listen(port,bind,()=>console.log(`GEV gateway ${bind}:${port}`));
''')

w('spatial-gev/adapters/gmri-world-source.js', r'''
export function createGmriWorldSource({baseUrl='http://127.0.0.1:9410'}={}) {
  return Object.freeze({
    async getSnapshot({signal}={}) {
      const r=await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/grizos/world`,{signal,cache:'no-store'});
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error(`GMRI world gateway ${r.status}`);
      const rows=await r.json();
      return rows.map((o)=>({
        id:String(o.object_id),
        type:String(o.object_type||'unknown'),
        state:o.state||{},
        provenance:o.provenance||{},
        confidence:o.confidence,
        sourceTime:o.source_time,
        updatedAt:o.updated_at,
      }));
    },
  });
}
''')

w('spatial-gev/adapters/gmri-world-layer.js', r'''
import * as Cesium from 'cesium';
import {registerEntityContext,removeEntityContextsForLayer} from '../../src/data/contextStore.js';
export function createGmriWorldLayer({source}={}){
  if(typeof source?.getSnapshot!=='function') throw new TypeError('GMRI world requires a snapshot source');
  let ds=null,enabled=false,req=null,count=0,lastUpdate=null,lastError=null;
  return {
    id:'gmri-world',name:'GMRI Canonical World',icon:'◆',source:'GrizOS',updateInterval:5000,
    init(viewer){ds=new Cesium.CustomDataSource('gmri-world');ds.show=false;viewer.dataSources.add(ds)},
    enable(){enabled=true;if(ds)ds.show=true},
    disable(){enabled=false;req?.abort();if(ds)ds.show=false;removeEntityContextsForLayer('gmri-world')},
    async update(){if(!enabled||!ds)return false;req?.abort();const r=new AbortController();req=r;try{const rows=await source.getSnapshot({signal:r.signal});if(r.signal.aborted||req!==r||!enabled)return false;const keep=new Set();ds.entities.removeAll();for(const row of rows){const lon=Number(row.state?.longitude??row.state?.lon),lat=Number(row.state?.latitude??row.state?.lat),alt=Number(row.state?.altitude_m??0);if(!Number.isFinite(lon)||!Number.isFinite(lat))continue;const id=String(row.id);keep.add(id);const entity=ds.entities.add({id:`gmri:${id}`,position:Cesium.Cartesian3.fromDegrees(lon,lat,Number.isFinite(alt)?alt:0),point:{pixelSize:9,color:Cesium.Color.CYAN,outlineColor:Cesium.Color.WHITE,outlineWidth:1},properties:{canonicalObjectId:id,objectType:row.type,provenance:JSON.stringify(row.provenance),confidence:row.confidence,sourceTime:row.sourceTime}});registerEntityContext(entity,{id,layerId:'gmri-world',name:id,type:row.type,lon,lat,alt,provenance:row.provenance,confidence:row.confidence,sourceTime:row.sourceTime});}removeEntityContextsForLayer('gmri-world',{retainIds:keep});count=keep.size;lastUpdate=Date.now();lastError=null;return true}catch(e){if(!r.signal.aborted){lastError=e?.message||String(e)}return false}finally{if(req===r)req=null}},
    destroy(viewer){req?.abort();removeEntityContextsForLayer('gmri-world');if(ds)viewer.dataSources.remove(ds,true);ds=null;enabled=false},
    getStats(){return{count,lastUpdate,error:lastError}}
  }
}
''')

w('spatial-gev/adapters/createApplicationGmriWorld.js', r'''
import {createGmriWorldLayer} from '../gmri-world-layer.js';
export function createApplicationGmriWorld({source}){return createGmriWorldLayer({source})}
''')

w('spatial-gev/deploy/patch_gev.sh', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
REPO=${1:?path to gods-eye-view worktree required}
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
[[ -d "$REPO/.git" || -f "$REPO/.git" ]] || { echo 'not a git worktree' >&2; exit 2; }
HEAD=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)
EXPECTED=b74a0233d9b94bd48329e60009d3877532e04ab2
if [[ "$HEAD" != "$EXPECTED" && "${2:-}" != --accept-new-base ]]; then
  echo "GEV base changed ($HEAD != $EXPECTED). Review current catalog/source seams; rerun with --accept-new-base only after reconciliation." >&2; exit 3
fi
[[ -z "$(git -C "$REPO" status --porcelain)" ]] || { echo 'GEV worktree is dirty; create a separate worktree/branch first.' >&2; exit 4; }
BR=gmri/grizos-world-$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)
git -C "$REPO" checkout -b "$BR"
install -D -m 0644 "$ROOT/spatial-gev/adapters/gmri-world-source.js" "$REPO/src/data/gmriWorld.js"
install -D -m 0644 "$ROOT/spatial-gev/adapters/gmri-world-layer.js" "$REPO/src/layers/gmriWorld/index.js"
python3 - "$REPO" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
repo=Path(sys.argv[1])
p=repo/'src/app/constructCatalog.js';s=p.read_text()
imports="import { createApplicationGmriWorld } from './layers/gmriWorld.js';\n"
if imports not in s:s=s.replace("import { createApplicationEarthquakes } from './layers/earthquakes.js';\n", "import { createApplicationEarthquakes } from './layers/earthquakes.js';\n"+imports)
s=s.replace("  earthquakes: ['getSnapshot'],\n", "  earthquakes: ['getSnapshot'],\n  'gmri-world': ['getSnapshot'],\n")
s=s.replace("        createApplicationEarthquakes({ source: sources.earthquakes }),\n", "        createApplicationEarthquakes({ source: sources.earthquakes }),\n        createApplicationGmriWorld({ source: sources['gmri-world'] }),\n")
p.write_text(s)
p=repo/'src/data/layerState.js';s=p.read_text()
# Refuse to guess registry layout; add metadata only when obvious anchor exists.
anchor="Object.freeze({ id: 'earthquakes'"
if "id: 'gmri-world'" not in s:
    idx=s.find(anchor)
    if idx<0: raise SystemExit('layerState registry anchor not found; patch manually from current source')
    # insert before earthquake entry preserving local style using a conservative literal.
    line="Object.freeze({ id: 'gmri-world', defaultEnabled: false, disposition: 'shareable' }),\n  "
    s=s[:idx]+line+s[idx:]
    p.write_text(s)
# app layer wrapper
q=repo/'src/app/layers/gmriWorld.js';q.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);q.write_text("export { createGmriWorldLayer as createApplicationGmriWorld } from '../../layers/gmriWorld/index.js';\n")
PY
# Source construction is app-specific and must be wired at the current source factory seam.
# The verifier refuses success until the source is actually present in the runtime catalog.
npm --prefix "$REPO" run format:check || true
npm --prefix "$REPO" run check:boundaries
npm --prefix "$REPO" test
cat <<EOF
Patch branch created: $BR
NEXT: wire sources['gmri-world'] = createGmriWorldSource({baseUrl:<internal gateway>}) at the current source-factory seam, then run spatial-gev/verification/verify_gev_projection.mjs. Do not expose the Vite server publicly.
EOF
''',0o755)

''')

w('apple-clients/GMRIGrizOSClient/Sources/GMRIGrizOSClient/GrizOSClient.swift', r'''
import Foundation

public struct GrizOSHealth: Codable, Sendable { public let status: String }
public struct GrizOSWorldObject: Codable, Sendable, Identifiable {
    public var id: String { object_id }
    public let object_id: String
    public let object_type: String
    public let state: [String: JSONValue]
    public let provenance: [String: JSONValue]
    public let confidence: Double?
    public let source_time: String?
    public let updated_at: String?
}
public enum JSONValue: Codable, Sendable {
    case string(String), number(Double), bool(Bool), object([String:JSONValue]), array([JSONValue]), null
    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws { let c=try decoder.singleValueContainer(); if c.decodeNil(){self = .null}else if let v=try? c.decode(Bool.self){self = .bool(v)}else if let v=try? c.decode(Double.self){self = .number(v)}else if let v=try? c.decode(String.self){self = .string(v)}else if let v=try? c.decode([String:JSONValue].self){self = .object(v)}else{self = .array(try c.decode([JSONValue].self))} }
    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws { var c=encoder.singleValueContainer();switch self{case .string(let v):try c.encode(v);case .number(let v):try c.encode(v);case .bool(let v):try c.encode(v);case .object(let v):try c.encode(v);case .array(let v):try c.encode(v);case .null:try c.encodeNil()} }
}

public actor GrizOSClient {
    private let baseURL: URL
    private let bearer: @Sendable () async throws -> String
    private let session: URLSession
    public init(baseURL: URL, session: URLSession = .shared, bearer: @escaping @Sendable () async throws -> String) { self.baseURL=baseURL;self.session=session;self.bearer=bearer }
    private func request(_ path: String) async throws -> URLRequest { var r=URLRequest(url:baseURL.appending(path:path));r.setValue("Bearer \(try await bearer())",forHTTPHeaderField:"Authorization");r.cachePolicy = .reloadIgnoringLocalCacheData;return r }
    public func health() async throws -> GrizOSHealth { let (d,r)=try await session.data(for: request("healthz"));guard (r as? HTTPURLResponse)?.statusCode==200 else{throw URLError(.badServerResponse)};return try JSONDecoder().decode(GrizOSHealth.self,from:d) }
    public func worldObjects() async throws -> [GrizOSWorldObject] { let (d,r)=try await session.data(for: request("v1/world/objects"));guard (r as? HTTPURLResponse)?.statusCode==200 else{throw URLError(.badServerResponse)};return try JSONDecoder().decode([GrizOSWorldObject].self,from:d) }
}
''')

echo 'No buildable Apple project found at target.' >&2; exit 2
''',0o755)

w('grizos/deploy/install_core.sh', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
[[ ${EUID:-$(id -u)} -eq 0 ]] || { echo 'root required' >&2; exit 2; }
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
STAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
REL=/opt/gmri/releases/$STAMP
# No prior generated packet is accepted as an install source.
if find "$ROOT" -type f \( -name 'GMRI_OVERNIGHT_DROP*' -o -name 'gmri-overnight-integration-plan.md' \) | grep -q .; then echo 'Contaminated generated packet material detected in production drop.' >&2; exit 3; fi
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y postgresql postgresql-client nodejs npm python3 python3-venv python3-pip git curl jq sqlite3 ca-certificates rsync openssl
install -d -m 0755 /opt/gmri/releases /etc/gmri/identities /etc/gmri/authority /etc/gmri/intelligence /etc/gmri/secrets /var/lib/gmri /var/log/gmri /var/backups/gmri
cp -a "$ROOT" "$REL"
ln -sfn "$REL" /opt/gmri/current
for u in grizos dottie dugan jones morita falsworth dernier; do id "gmri-$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --home "/var/lib/gmri/$u" --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin "gmri-$u"; done
id grizos >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --home /var/lib/gmri/grizos --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin grizos
# grizos user might have been created as gmri-grizos above; ensure dedicated control-plane identity exists.
if ! id grizos >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --system --home /var/lib/gmri/grizos --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin grizos; fi
for u in dottie dugan jones morita falsworth dernier; do install -d -m 0700 -o "gmri-$u" -g "gmri-$u" "/var/lib/gmri/memory/$u"; done
# HoloGraph: existing local repo wins if GMRI_HOLOGRAPH_SOURCE is supplied by discovery; otherwise clone the observed real GMRI repo.
python3 -m venv /opt/gmri/venv-holograph
/opt/gmri/venv-holograph/bin/pip install --upgrade pip
HGSRC=${GMRI_HOLOGRAPH_SOURCE:-}
if [[ -n "$HGSRC" ]]; then [[ -d "$HGSRC/.git" ]] || { echo 'GMRI_HOLOGRAPH_SOURCE is not a git repo' >&2; exit 4; }; else HGSRC=/opt/gmri/src/holograph-memory; mkdir -p /opt/gmri/src; if [[ ! -d "$HGSRC/.git" ]]; then git clone https://github.com/oldmangrizzz/holograph-memory.git "$HGSRC"; fi; fi

# PostgreSQL canonical store.

if ! sudo -u postgres psql -Atc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='grizos'" | grep -qx 1; then sudo -u postgres createdb -O grizos grizos; fi
sudo -u grizos psql -d grizos -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /opt/gmri/current/grizos/migrations/001_schema.sql
# Install immutable identity and authority configs.
install -m 0644 /opt/gmri/current/dottie/identity/dottie.identity.json /etc/gmri/identities/
for f in /opt/gmri/current/aegis/identities/*.identity.json; do install -m 0644 "$f" /etc/gmri/identities/; done
for f in /opt/gmri/current/grizos/config/authority/*.json; do install -m 0644 "$f" /etc/gmri/authority/; done

install -m 0644 /opt/gmri/current/spatial-gev/config/gev-gateway.env.example /etc/gmri/gev-gateway.env
# Repo allowlist is created from operator/live discovery; never guess paths.
: > /etc/gmri/repo-allowlist.txt
chmod 0644 /etc/gmri/repo-allowlist.txt
# Per-intelligence envs.

chmod 0640 "/etc/gmri/intelligence/$u.env"; chown root:"gmri-$u" "/etc/gmri/intelligence/$u.env"; }
mk_env dottie 'gmri:dottie-hill' dottie.identity.json glm-5.3:cloud 9501

w('acceptance/_lib.sh', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/opt/gmri/current
TOKEN_DIR=/etc/gmri/secrets/tokens
BASE=http://127.0.0.1:9400
require_live(){ [[ "${GMRI_TEST_MODE:-0}" != 1 ]] || { echo 'TEST_MODE prohibited for production acceptance' >&2; exit 90; }; curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:9400/healthz >/dev/null; }
tok(){ cat "$TOKEN_DIR/$1.token"; }
api(){ local who=$1; shift; curl --fail --silent --show-error -H "Authorization: Bearer $(tok "$who")" "$@"; }
record(){ local name=$1 status=$2 detail=${3:-}; printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$status" "$detail"; }
''',0o755)

w('acceptance/dispatch.sh', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source /opt/gmri/current/acceptance/_lib.sh; require_live
REPO=$(grep -E '/gods-eye-view$' /etc/gmri/repo-allowlist.txt | head -n1 || true); [[ -n "$REPO" ]] || { echo 'gods-eye-view repo not allowlisted' >&2; exit 2; }
HEAD=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)
IK="acceptance:dispatch:$HEAD"
body=$(jq -n --arg ik "$IK" --arg repo "$REPO" '{idempotency_key:$ik,assigned_id:"gmri:dottie-hill",mission_type:"repo_watch",consequence_class:"READ_ONLY",authority_scope:["OBSERVE","RETRIEVE","COMPARE","REASON","COLLECT_EVIDENCE","REPORT"],payload:{repo_path:$repo,repo_match:"gods-eye-view",query:"Production acceptance: inspect the actual current GEV repo and dispatch independent review.",aegis_reviewers:["gmri:aegis:dugan","gmri:aegis:morita"]}}')
api field -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$body" "$BASE/v1/missions" > /tmp/mission.json
MID=$(jq -r .mission_id /tmp/mission.json)
for _ in $(seq 1 90); do sleep 2; F=$(api operator "$BASE/v1/findings?mission_id=$MID"); [[ $(jq 'length' <<<"$F") -ge 1 ]] && break; done
# Wait for AEGIS child missions/findings.
for _ in $(seq 1 90); do sleep 2; ALL=$(api operator "$BASE/v1/events?after=0"); n=$(jq --arg mid "$MID" '[.[]|select(.event_type=="MISSION_DISPATCHED" and .payload.idempotency_key|contains($mid))]|length' <<<"$ALL" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [[ "$n" -ge 2 ]] && break; done
# Verify actual provider inference manifested as findings from Dottie and AEGIS.
D=$(api operator "$BASE/v1/findings?mission_id=$MID"); [[ $(jq 'length' <<<"$D") -ge 1 ]] || exit 3
record dottie_dispatch PASS "$MID"
''',0o755)

w('acceptance/restart_recovery.sh', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source /opt/gmri/current/acceptance/_lib.sh; require_live
REPO=$(grep -E '/holograph-memory$' /etc/gmri/repo-allowlist.txt | head -n1 || true); [[ -n "$REPO" ]] || { echo 'holograph-memory repo not allowlisted' >&2; exit 2; }
IK="acceptance:kill-reconcile:$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)"
body=$(jq -n --arg ik "$IK" --arg repo "$REPO" '{idempotency_key:$ik,assigned_id:"gmri:aegis:morita",mission_type:"repo_watch",consequence_class:"READ_ONLY",payload:{repo_path:$repo,query:"Inspect real HoloGraph repo; acceptance will kill this worker during execution."}}')
api operator -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$body" "$BASE/v1/missions" >/tmp/restart-mission.json
MID=$(jq -r .mission_id /tmp/restart-mission.json)
sleep 1
systemctl kill -s KILL gmri-intelligence@morita.service
sleep 5
systemctl is-active --quiet gmri-intelligence@morita.service
for _ in $(seq 1 90); do sleep 2; E=$(api operator "$BASE/v1/events?after=0"); if jq -e --arg mid "$MID" '.[]|select(.mission_id==$mid and .event_type=="MISSION_COMPLETED")' <<<"$E" >/dev/null; then record restart_reconciliation PASS "$MID"; exit 0; fi; done
echo 'mission did not complete after restart reconciliation' >&2; exit 4
''',0o755)

w('acceptance/gev_projection.sh', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source /opt/gmri/current/acceptance/_lib.sh; require_live
# Use a real public USGS source; no fixture. If WAN is unavailable this check is DEGRADED, not forged.
TMP=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 15 https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/v1.0/summary/all_hour.geojson > "$TMP"
OID=$(jq -r '.features[0].id' "$TMP"); LON=$(jq -r '.features[0].geometry.coordinates[0]' "$TMP"); LAT=$(jq -r '.features[0].geometry.coordinates[1]' "$TMP"); DEP=$(jq -r '.features[0].geometry.coordinates[2]' "$TMP"); MAG=$(jq -r '.features[0].properties.mag' "$TMP"); TIME=$(jq -r '.features[0].properties.time' "$TMP")
[[ "$OID" != null && -n "$OID" ]] || { echo 'USGS feed had no events in current hour' >&2; exit 20; }
HASH=$(sha256sum "$TMP"|awk '{print $1}')
body=$(jq -n --arg oid "usgs:$OID" --argjson lon "$LON" --argjson lat "$LAT" --argjson dep "$DEP" --argjson mag "$MAG" --arg hash "$HASH" '{object_id:$oid,object_type:"earthquake",state:{longitude:$lon,latitude:$lat,depth_km:$dep,magnitude:$mag},provenance:{source:"USGS all_hour GeoJSON",source_uri:"https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/v1.0/summary/all_hour.geojson",payload_sha256:$hash},confidence:1.0,event_type:"OBSERVED"}')
api operator -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$body" "$BASE/v1/world/objects" >/tmp/world.json
node /opt/gmri/current/spatial-gev/verification/verify_gev_projection.mjs
record gev_projection PASS "$(jq -r .object_id /tmp/world.json)"
''',0o755)

w('acceptance/production_acceptance.sh', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/opt/gmri/current
[[ ${EUID:-$(id -u)} -eq 0 ]] || { echo 'root required' >&2; exit 2; }
[[ "${GMRI_TEST_MODE:-0}" != 1 ]] || { echo 'TEST_MODE prohibited' >&2; exit 90; }
RID=${GMRI_RUN_ID:-$(cat "$ROOT/runs/CURRENT" 2>/dev/null || true)}; [[ -n "$RID" ]] || { echo 'run id missing' >&2; exit 3; }
OUT="$ROOT/runs/$RID/EVIDENCE/production-acceptance.tsv"; : > "$OUT"
run(){ local n=$1; shift; if "$@" >> "$OUT" 2>&1; then echo -e "$n\tPASS" >> "$OUT"; else rc=$?; echo -e "$n\tFAIL\trc=$rc" >> "$OUT"; return $rc; fi; }
run health "$ROOT/operations/health.sh"
run authority "$ROOT/acceptance/authority.sh"
run memory_isolation "$ROOT/acceptance/memory_isolation.sh"
run dispatch "$ROOT/acceptance/dispatch.sh"
run restart_recovery "$ROOT/acceptance/restart_recovery.sh"
run provider_degradation "$ROOT/acceptance/provider_degradation.sh"
run gev_projection "$ROOT/acceptance/gev_projection.sh"
run backup_restore "$ROOT/acceptance/backup_restore.sh"
# independent_recon requires externally captured observer post-state and is a hard gate when available.
if [[ -s "$ROOT/runs/$RID/DISCOVERY/proxmox-post-observer.json" ]]; then run independent_recon "$ROOT/acceptance/independent_recon.sh"; else echo -e "independent_recon\tBLOCKED\tmissing observer post-state" >> "$OUT"; fi
python3 - "$OUT" "$ROOT/runs/$RID/ACCEPTANCE.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
rows=[]; hard_fail=False; blocked=False
for line in open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf-8'):
    parts=line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
    if len(parts)>=2 and parts[1] in {'PASS','FAIL','BLOCKED'}:
        rows.append({'check':parts[0],'status':parts[1],'detail':'\t'.join(parts[2:])})
        hard_fail |= parts[1]=='FAIL'; blocked |= parts[1]=='BLOCKED'
status='FAIL' if hard_fail else ('BLOCKED' if blocked else 'PASS')
json.dump({'status':status,'checks':rows},open(sys.argv[2],'w'),indent=2)
print(status)
raise SystemExit(0 if status=='PASS' else 2)
PY
''',0o755)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Packet validator
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
w('bootstrap/validate_packet.py', r'''
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json,os,re,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]).resolve()
errors=[]; warnings=[]
required=['START_HERE.md','PRODUCTION_MISSION.md','SOURCE_AUTHORITY.md','CLEAN_ROOM_ATTESTATION.md','LIVE_DISCOVERY.md','ARCHITECTURE_CONSTITUTION.md','PRODUCTION_TOPOLOGY.md','RESOURCE_BLUEPRINT.md','SECURITY_AUTHORITY.md','MODEL_ROUTING.md','MEMORY_POLICY.md','EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE.md','FIELD_MISSION_SET.md','FIELD_OPERATIONS.md','RECOVERY.md','ROLLBACK.md','ACCEPTANCE.md','FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.md','MORNING_HANDOFF.md']
for r in required:
 p=root/r
 if not p.is_file() or p.stat().st_size<100: errors.append(f'missing/substantive required file: {r}')
# Clean room contamination.
for p in root.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file() and (p.name.startswith('GMRI_OVERNIGHT_DROP') or p.name=='gmri-overnight-integration-plan.md'): errors.append(f'contaminated prior generated artifact: {p.relative_to(root)}')
# Forbidden product component.
for p in root.rglob('*'):
 if not p.is_file() or p.suffix.lower() in {'.pdf','.docx','.zip'}: continue
 try:s=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
 except:continue
 if re.search(r'(?i)\bOcta\b',s) and p.name not in {'CONFLICT_REGISTER.md','ARCHITECTURE_CONSTITUTION.md','PRODUCTION_MISSION.md'}: errors.append(f'forbidden Octa reference outside conflict/constitution docs: {p.relative_to(root)}')
# Stale typo deliberately mentioned in START_HERE must not survive final packet.
for p in root.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in {'.md','.sh','.py','.mjs','.js','.json'}:
  s=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
  if 'proxxmox/' in s: errors.append(f'stale path typo proxxmox: {p.relative_to(root)}')
# Secrets heuristic.
secret_patterns=[r'(?i)api[_-]?key\s*[=:]\s*["\']?[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20,}',r'(?i)token_value\s*[=:]\s*["\']?[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20,}',r'-----BEGIN .*PRIVATE KEY-----']
for p in root.rglob('*'):
 if not p.is_file() or p.suffix.lower() in {'.pdf','.docx','.zip'}: continue
 s=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
 for pat in secret_patterns:
  if re.search(pat,s): errors.append(f'possible embedded secret in {p.relative_to(root)}')

# GMRI Production Deployment — START HERE

**Hard gate:** Thursday, 08 October 2026 at 23:59 local time.

**Field-test subject:** GrizOS + Dottie Hill + AEGIS / Howling Commandos. OMP/OpenRig are the engineering shipyard, not the ship.

## Mission
Deploy the strongest real GMRI implementation onto the authorized GMRI production substrate, integrate the actual GrizOS control-plane boundaries, persistent Dottie identity, persistent AEGIS identities, real model routing, durable state/evidence/authority, GEV projection, recovery, security, observability, and field operations. The Friday–Saturday test asks whether Dottie and AEGIS can hold the watch through GrizOS while the operator is physically away.

## Absolute clean-room rule
Do **not** read, import, copy, patch, diff against, or use as implementation input any prior generated `GMRI_OVERNIGHT_DROP*` packet or `gmri-overnight-integration-plan.md`. This packet was generated from the authoritative sources in `SOURCE_MATERIAL/`, the current mission, and observed real repositories. `bootstrap/clean_room_guard.py` enforces the input-path denylist during this run.

## First invocation
From the extracted packet root, use the installed OMP syntax as the authority. The known-good prior OMP handoff used:

```sh
omp @PRODUCTION_MISSION.md "$(cat START.md)"
```

If the installed `omp --help` says the attachment/invocation syntax differs, adapt to the installed binary and record the exact invocation in the durable run receipt. Do not guess.

## First execution sequence

```sh
python3 bootstrap/clean_room_guard.py --packet-root "$PWD"
python3 bootstrap/initialize_run_state.py --runs-root "$PWD/runs"
bash bootstrap/preflight.sh
python3 bootstrap/discover_repos.py --out "$(cat .current_run)/EVIDENCE/repositories.json"
bash bootstrap/discover_versions.sh "$(cat .current_run)/EVIDENCE/versions.txt"
python3 models/verify_ollama_models.py --out "$(cat .current_run)/EVIDENCE/model-routing-observed.json"
```

Then the primary OMP coordinator MUST:

1. read `SOURCE_AUTHORITY.md` and the source files under `SOURCE_MATERIAL/`;
2. inspect live local repositories/worktrees and compare them to `REPO_OBSERVATIONS.json`;
3. identify the real implementation pieces for GrizOS/Dottie/AEGIS/Apple/GEV before writing new product code;
4. classify each selected piece using `REAL / EXECUTABLE`, `TESTED, BUT NARROW`, `IMPLEMENTED, NOT VERIFIED`, `SCAFFOLD / PLACEHOLDER`, `DOCUMENTED, NOT IMPLEMENTED`, `OVERCLAIMED`, or `UNKNOWN`;
5. write exact immutable component locks with `bootstrap/lock_component.py`; locks must contain the source path/repository, commit, build command, runtime command, health command, persistent state paths, authority boundary, and backup paths;
6. discover the live Proxmox environment through the independent observer lane, normalize the observation with `proxmox/observer/record_inventory.py`, write `selection-policy.json` from observed/known-good node+storage+bridge evidence, then run `python3 proxmox/resource_blueprint/resolve_blueprint.py --inventory <normalized-observer.json> --policy <selection-policy.json> --out <run>/EVIDENCE/resolved-blueprint.json`;
7. establish rollback before any Proxmox mutation;
8. apply infrastructure through the Proxmox operator lane and independently verify it through the observer lane;
9. stage exact locked releases into the production guests and install them with `proxmox/deploy/guest_apply.py` / rendered systemd units; do not replace selected real product code with a reference runtime;
10. integrate the existing `oldmangrizzz/gods-eye-view` fork as the macro plane and use the GrizOS projection gateway only as a projection boundary;
11. build/deploy real Apple client code discovered from the current repository tree; never substitute a CLI for an existing product surface;
12. run `acceptance/production_acceptance.py` against the running deployed services and execute the live acceptance commands recorded in the component locks;
13. perform restart/reconciliation, authority-denial, memory-isolation, real dispatch/inference, GEV projection, provider-degradation, backup/restore, and independent Proxmox recon acceptance;
14. transition to `operations/field_start.py` only after the deployed services—not the test suite—satisfy the evidence-backed field gate.

## Durable run state
`bootstrap/initialize_run_state.py` writes the active run directory path to `.current_run`. Each run contains:

`MISSION.json`, `STATE.json`, `CHECKPOINT.md`, `EVENTS.jsonl`, `COMMANDS.jsonl`, `EVIDENCE/`, `ACCEPTANCE.json`, `RECOVERY.json`.

Before each consequential mutation, record intended change, observed pre-state, authority, expected result, rollback, and evidence path. After restart: **READ DURABLE STATE → INSPECT REALITY → COMPARE → RECONCILE → ONLY THEN CONTINUE.**

## Authority
Default unattended authority is: OBSERVE, RETRIEVE, COMPARE, REASON, INVESTIGATE, COLLECT EVIDENCE, REPORT, ALERT. Mutations require pre-existing authority and must be bounded, reversible, and idempotent. No component may grant itself authority, weaken TLS, broaden Proxmox privilege, invent credentials, expose arbitrary public ports, delete evidence, or rewrite identity/memory policy.

## Proxmox
Production Proxmox is in scope unless live discovery proves the canonical production substrate already exists elsewhere and satisfies the same requirements. Use:

- **operator lane:** ProxmoxMCP-Plus for authorized lifecycle/storage/snapshot/backup/rollback/jobs;
- **observer lane:** sergelogvinov/proxmox-mcp for independent inventory and post-change verification.

The builder does not certify itself. IDs, addresses, bridges, storage pools and capacities are resolved from live inventory—never from this packet.

## Completion
Packet execution is complete only when the running production system has evidence for service supervision/reboot survival, persistent canonical state, persistent Dottie and AEGIS identities, real inference and dispatch, real evidence provenance, authority enforcement, private-memory isolation, GEV projection, restart reconciliation, backup/restore, degraded-provider behavior, independent infrastructure verification, and a field mission set that continues when interactive OMP/OpenRig is closed.

A real blocker is recorded as `BLOCKED_REQUIRES_OPERATOR` with the smallest concrete operator action. A blocked branch does not stop safe independent work elsewhere.

===== PRODUCTION_MISSION.md =====
# GMRI Production Deployment Mission

## Objective
By Thursday 08 October 2026 at 23:59 local time, produce the strongest evidence-backed operational deployment of **GrizOS + Dottie Hill + AEGIS / Howling Commandos** on GMRI-authorized infrastructure. Friday through Saturday, the deployed system must perform useful bounded watch work while the operator is away.

## Production-first rule
Production services are the object under test. Tests, canaries, fixtures and smoke checks may verify the product; none of them may substitute for a required production service, live data source, persistent intelligence, canonical state store, real model inference, or deployed endpoint.

## Existing-code-first rule
Inspect and integrate the strongest real GMRI implementation before writing new product code. New code is permitted for missing production adapters, configuration, migrations, deployment mechanics, or requirements not present in the real implementation. Every new code path must identify the missing requirement it closes.

## Required product boundaries
- **GrizOS**: operating environment/control plane for canonical world state, intelligence registration, identity boundaries, authority, provenance, durable mission/run state, capability routing, endpoint registration, receipts, continuity/reconciliation and GEV projection boundaries.
- **Dottie Hill**: persistent digital intelligence whose identity survives replacement of model/provider/worker/framework/tool/renderer/process/host; watch officer, provenance librarian, semantic translator, adversarial reader, institutional memory within explicit boundaries; not final authority.
- **AEGIS / Howling Commandos**: separate persistent intelligences with distinct identities, private memory, salience, competence, trust/failure histories, authority and operational histories. They are not prompts, personas, disposable workers, or one model identity wearing five names.
- **GEV**: first-class macro spatial plane and projection of canonical GrizOS world state; never canonical identity/memory/truth/mission authority.
- **OMP/OpenRig**: engineering shipyard only; not canonical state and not a field-runtime dependency.

## Identity invariants
Persist for Dottie at minimum: `intelligence_id`, `identity_manifest_ref`, `lineage_version`, `memory_namespace_ref`, `authority_profile_ref`, `relationship_state_ref`, `active_model_binding`, `model_binding_history`.

Preserve `intelligence_id = persistent intelligence` and `worker_id = disposable execution environment`. Destroying or replacing a worker must not destroy an intelligence.

## AEGIS differentiation
- Dugan: people / action / consequences. Humor and seriousness are coupled; humor is a load-bearing regulatory behavior, not evidence that stakes are low.
- Jones: context / legitimacy / competing obligations.
- Morita: actual problem vs bad assumption.
- Falsworth: obligation / institution / continuity / succession.
- Dernier: local action when formal machinery fails.

No GMRI subsystem named `Octa` may be created.

## Required field acceptance
Acceptance must demonstrate the deployed system with real services, real inference, real approved sources, actual durable state, actual authority enforcement, actual restart/reconciliation, actual memory isolation, actual GEV projection, actual backup/restore and independent Proxmox observation. Detailed gates are in `ACCEPTANCE.md`.
===== PRODUCTION_TOPOLOGY.md =====
# Production Topology

This is a **logical production topology**. Live discovery resolves existing resources, IDs, addresses, bridges, storage and capacity before mutation.

## Sovereign service plane
Prefer existing canonical GMRI resources when they satisfy the production service standard. If no suitable canonical resources exist, the resource resolver provisions the minimum isolated resources necessary for the deadline:

- **gmri-core**: GrizOS control plane, canonical durable mission/evidence/identity/authority state, Dottie runtime, AEGIS dispatch/runtime, memory/context adapter(s), model-routing adapter, health/observability and recovery services.
- **gmri-gev**: existing God's Eye View application plus narrow GrizOS projection gateway. GEV remains read/projection-side relative to canonical GrizOS state.

A service may remain on a previously deployed canonical host if live inspection establishes that doing so is safer and preserves the constitution. The decision is written to `RESOURCE_BLUEPRINT.md` and the run evidence.

## Operator/engineering plane
MacBook / primary local OMP: coordination, OpenRig workers, worktrees, Apple builds and secure operator access. It is not automatically canonical state and the field runtime must continue if OMP/OpenRig exits.

## Apple/field plane
Discover existing macOS/iPadOS/iOS code first. The PRD requires real local Apple capability, voice-first interaction, intent-first/generated UI, spatial state and meaningful offline behavior. Existing product surfaces are built/deployed; they are not replaced by a CLI merely because a CLI is easier to automate.

## External/provider plane
External model/data providers remain replaceable dependencies with explicit source/freshness/degraded state. Provider loss cannot silently rewrite canonical state or identity.
===== RESOURCE_BLUEPRINT.md =====
# Resource Blueprint

`proxmox/resource_blueprint/desired_resources.json` defines the minimum logical resources. `resolve_blueprint.py` combines it with a normalized observer inventory and emits the concrete collision-free resource blueprint into the active run's evidence directory.

The resolver never invents a live network, storage pool, VM/LXC ID or capacity. If the observer inventory is incomplete, it returns `BLOCKED_REQUIRES_OPERATOR` for that resource rather than guessing.

Existing resources are adopted only after they are classified as canonical/appropriate and pass required health/state checks. New resources require rollback/snapshot/backup references before mutation.

## Executable resolution

1. Observer lane writes the normalized inventory.
2. OMP identifies the current GMRI production node/storage/bridge from observed known-good state and writes a copy of `proxmox/resource_blueprint/selection-policy.example.json` with those exact observed names and an evidence reference.
3. Run:

```sh
python3 proxmox/resource_blueprint/resolve_blueprint.py --inventory <observer.json> --policy <selection-policy.json> --out <resolved-blueprint.json>
```

The resolver refuses to pick the first network/storage/node. It only resolves IDs after the explicit live selection policy matches the observer inventory.

===== spatial-gev/adapters/grizos_projection_gateway.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Narrow read-only projection gateway derived from the GMRI spatial architecture.
# It never writes canonical state. On upstream failure it serves last-known-good with explicit stale/degraded metadata.
import json,os,time,urllib.request,threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
SNAP=os.environ['GRIZOS_SNAPSHOT_URL']; EVENTS=os.environ['GRIZOS_EVENTS_URL']; BIND=os.getenv('GEV_GATEWAY_BIND','127.0.0.1'); PORT=int(os.getenv('GEV_GATEWAY_PORT','8766')); STALE=int(os.getenv('GEV_STALE_AFTER_SECONDS','60'))
cache={'snapshot':None,'events':None,'snapshot_at':0.0,'events_at':0.0,'errors':{}}
def fetch(k,url):
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=5) as r: data=json.load(r)
        cache[k]=data; cache[k+'_at']=time.time(); cache['errors'].pop(k,None)
    except Exception as e: cache['errors'][k]=str(e)
def loop():
    while True:
        fetch('snapshot',SNAP); fetch('events',EVENTS); time.sleep(5)
class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def sendj(self,o,status=200):
        b=json.dumps(o).encode(); self.send_response(status); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(b))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b)
    def do_GET(self):
        now=time.time()

        if self.path=='/snapshot': return self.sendj({'canonical':False,'projection_only':True,'stale':not cache['snapshot_at'] or now-cache['snapshot_at']>STALE,'observed_at':cache['snapshot_at'],'upstream':SNAP,'data':cache['snapshot'],'error':cache['errors'].get('snapshot')},200 if cache['snapshot'] is not None else 503)
        if self.path=='/events': return self.sendj({'canonical':False,'projection_only':True,'stale':not cache['events_at'] or now-cache['events_at']>STALE,'observed_at':cache['events_at'],'upstream':EVENTS,'data':cache['events'],'error':cache['errors'].get('events')},200 if cache['events'] is not None else 503)
        self.sendj({'error':'not found'},404)
    def log_message(self,fmt,*args): return
threading.Thread(target=loop,daemon=True).start(); ThreadingHTTPServer((BIND,PORT),H).serve_forever()

===== acceptance/_live.py =====
import json,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
BANNED=('fixture','mock','counter','testdata')
def load(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def cmd_ok(cmd):
    if not isinstance(cmd,list) or not cmd: raise ValueError('missing live argv command')
    s=' '.join(cmd).lower()
    if any(x in s for x in BANNED): raise ValueError('synthetic acceptance command forbidden: '+s)
    return cmd
def run(cmd):
    q=subprocess.run(cmd_ok(cmd),capture_output=True,text=True); return {'exit':q.returncode,'output':(q.stdout+q.stderr)[-12000:]}
def hash_path(p):
    p=Path(p); h=hashlib.sha256()
    if p.is_file(): h.update(p.read_bytes())
    elif p.is_dir():
        for f in sorted(x for x in p.rglob('*') if x.is_file()): h.update(str(f.relative_to(p)).encode()); h.update(f.read_bytes())
    else: return None
    return h.hexdigest()

[1215] assistant (text, 3005 chars)
Yeah — there’s a very plausible pathophysiologic loop there, and the **hyperglycemia + gastroparesis interaction** is probably the piece you were reaching for.

Acute hyperglycemia can **further slow gastric emptying**, even apart from whatever caused her gastroparesis. It suppresses antral pressure waves, disrupts coordinated antroduodenal motility, and increases pyloric contractions. Those changes bias the stomach toward retaining contents longer. This has been demonstrated even in people without diabetic gastroparesis, although the magnitude varies. citeturn224562search0turn224562search36

Then you get a nasty little feedback loop:

**gastroparesis → delayed/unpredictable nutrient delivery → wonky glucose excursion → hyperglycemia → even slower gastric emptying → more retained gastric volume/distention → more opportunity for reflux.**

That last step makes mechanical sense because gastric distention is a major driver of postprandial transient LES relaxations/reflux. citeturn467039search7

The **black pepper is probably more amplifier than primary cause**. The evidence that “spicy food” meaningfully lowers LES pressure is actually weak; ACG notes that spicy foods have little demonstrated effect on LES pressure. But they can provoke **esophageal burning through direct chemosensory/mucosal irritation**, so you can experience substantially worse heartburn without necessarily having dramatically more reflux events. citeturn467039search4turn467039search5 Piperine is a pungent sensory compound, so that mechanism is quite plausible for black pepper specifically, although the direct black-pepper/gastroparesis human literature is thin.

And then there’s the cottage cheese itself: **if it’s higher-fat cottage cheese**, fat will further slow gastric emptying and can worsen reflux tendency. Gastroparesis diets commonly emphasize lower-fat meals for exactly that reason. citeturn224562search38

So if I had to model what she noticed this morning:

**cottage cheese ± fat + baseline gastroparesis**  
→ prolonged gastric residence  
→ **elevated glucose further impairs antral emptying / increases pyloric resistance**  
→ stomach stays fuller longer  
→ increased reflux opportunity  
→ **pepper makes whatever reaches the esophagus burn more intensely**  
→ afternoon heartburn despite the meal being hours earlier.

And there’s a reciprocal piece worth watching in your trending: **gastroparesis itself can make glucose peaks occur later than expected**, because carbohydrate delivery to the small intestine is delayed and variable. So the high glucose may not simply be an upstream trigger; it can be both **consequence and perpetuator** of the slowed emptying.

So no, you weren’t imagining a missing mechanism. There absolutely is one. The most interesting thing to trend would probably be **meal fat content, glucose at meal / +1 / +2 / +4 hours, onset of fullness/bloating, and onset of reflux**, because the *timing* may tell you more than the food label itself.
